title: Massage & Reflexology Bliss at Nomad Organic Foot Spa – Up to 22% Off Restorative 60-90 Minute Packages
description:
Weekday Wellness Awaits at Nomad Organic Foot Spa
  Choose from Three Restorative Massage Packages | Valid Monday–Thursday
  Feeling stressed, tense, or just in need of a well-deserved break? Reclaim your calm at 
    Nomad Organic Foot Spa, a modern eco-friendly oasis nestled in the heart of the city. 
    Our certified reflexologists and experienced therapists offer thoughtfully curated treatments that blend 
    traditional techniques with natural healing practices to leave you feeling refreshed, balanced, and deeply relaxed.
  
  What We Offer:
  Choose from three therapeutic options, each designed to relieve tension, promote circulation, 
    and support whole-body wellness:
  
  
    
      60-Minute Organic Herbal Foot Reflexology + Asian Body Works (Tui Na) Combo:
      A head-to-toe experience that merges the grounding effects of herbal foot reflexology with full-body Tui Na massage techniques. 
      Great for those who want both localized and overall relief.
    
    
      60-Minute Asian Body Works (Tui Na) Massage with Hot Stones:
      Melt muscle tension and stress with traditional Tui Na methods enhanced by the comforting warmth of hot stones. 
      This service targets deep layers of muscle to promote long-term relaxation and wellness.
    
    
      90-Minute Package: 60-Minute Tui Na Massage + 30-Minute Reflexology with Hot Stones:
      Enjoy the ultimate relaxation duo—Tui Na massage to restore energy flow and balance, 
      followed by soothing reflexology with hot stones to stimulate foot pressure points linked to organ systems.
    
  
  Why You Should Grab This Offer:
  
    Nomad Organic Foot Spa is more than a massage studio—it's a sanctuary. With a stellar 
    4.8-star rating on Groupon, we’re known for our serene ambiance, walk-in convenience, 
    and eco-conscious approach. Our team of nationally certified reflexologists (ARCB) 
    brings expert knowledge to every session, customizing treatments to meet your specific needs.
  
  
    Herbal aromatherapy to elevate each massage experience
    Sustainable practices and naturally derived products
    Unique therapies like hot stones and herbal ball treatments
    Convenient weekday availability for spontaneous self-care
  
  
    Whether you're seeking deep tissue recovery, energy balance, or simple tranquility, 
    our weekday wellness packages offer the perfect escape. 
    Unplug from the chaos—your body and mind deserve it.

faqs.question: What massage and reflexology package options does Nomad Organic Foot Spa offer?
faqs.answer: Nomad Organic Foot Spa offers three package options: a 60-Minute Organic Herbal Foot Reflexology Massage with Asian Body Works Combo, a 60-Minute Asian Body Works (Tuina) with Hot Stones Massage, and a 60-Minute Tuina Massage with 30-Minute Reflexology Package. All three options are valid Monday through Thursday.

faqs.question: Where is the Nomad Organic Foot Spa location that offers these massage and reflexology packages?
faqs.answer: The redemption location for these packages is Nomad Organic Foot Spa at 408 Harvard Street, Brookline, MA 02446. Customers have also noted that the spa has at least one additional location in Newton.

faqs.question: What days of the week are the Experience Relaxation with 60-90min Massage and Reflexology Packages available?
faqs.answer: All three massage and reflexology package options at Nomad Organic Foot Spa are valid Monday through Thursday only.
